| Category = Tofu recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 block [[Cookbook:Tofu|firm tofu]]
* Mixture of preferred vegetables (suggested combination: [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green pepper]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]])
* ½ [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]
* [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|Soy sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], [[Cookbook:Hot Pepper Sauce|hot sauce]], [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]])

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] tofu into manageable slices (no more than ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick).
# Slice all vegetables and apple.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] tofu and vegetable in a light mixture of olive oil and soy sauce on medium high heat.
# Cook until tofu is golden brown and vegetables have thoroughly soaked up juices.
# Serve with a side of [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] or [[Cookbook:Couscous|couscous]] and season.
